sets.note: Give two reasons. 最初に意見（Yes / No か、どちらか）。理由を2つ、それぞれ1〜2文で支え、最後にもう一度意見。理由の例：通勤の時間がいらない・インターネットで会議ができる／会社で会って話す方が早い・家で集中しにくい、など。

sets.prompt:
●外国人の知り合いから、次の QUESTION をされました。
●QUESTION について、あなたの意見とその理由を2つ英語で書いてください。
●語数の目安は50〜60語です。

QUESTION
Which do you think is better for children, playing outside or playing video games at home?
sets.note: Give two reasons. 最初に意見（Yes / No か、どちらか）。理由を2つ、それぞれ1〜2文で支え、最後にもう一度意見。理由の例：どちらかを選ぶ。外＝体が強くなる・友達と協力を学ぶ、ゲーム＝天気に関係ない・考える力がつく。

sets.prompt:
●外国人の知り合いから、次の QUESTION をされました。
●QUESTION について、あなたの意見とその理由を2つ英語で書いてください。
●語数の目安は50〜60語です。

QUESTION
Do you think people should use buses and trains more often instead of cars?
sets.note: Give two reasons. 最初に意見（Yes / No か、どちらか）。理由を2つ、それぞれ1〜2文で支え、最後にもう一度意見。理由の例：空気がきれいになる・道路が混まない／荷物が多い時に不便・田舎ではバスが少ない、など。

parts.title: リスニング第1部 会話の応答文選択
parts.desc: 短い会話の最後の発言に対する応答を、読み上げられる3つから選ぶ。放送は1回
parts.tip: 最後の1文が勝負。疑問詞（When / How long / What kind）を聞き取り、その答えの形になっている選択肢を選ぶ。会話に出た語をくり返す選択肢はわなが多い。
parts.intro: Listen to the conversation. Choose the best response to the last remark from the three choices.

sets.script:
M: Hi, Jenny. You look really happy today.
W: I am. I got my math test back this morning, and I got the highest score in my class.
M: Wow, that's great! How did you study for it?

questions.q: Choose the best response.
choices: I'll take the test next week.
I practiced with old tests every night.
questions.why: How did you study?（どうやって勉強したの）には勉強の方法を答える。テストはもう返ってきたので「来週受ける」は合わない。

sets.script:
W: Excuse me. I'm looking for a birthday present for my father.
M: How about this tie? It's very popular this season.
W: Hmm, he doesn't wear ties very often. Do you have anything else?

questions.q: Choose the best response.
choices: Yes, he looks nice in it.
questions.why: 「ほかに何かありますか」と聞かれた店員は、別の品物を勧める。父親はここにいないので「似合う」は合わない。

sets.script:
M: Mom, have you seen my soccer shoes? I can't find them anywhere.
W: Did you leave them in the car after practice yesterday?
M: Maybe. Can I have the car key so I can go and look?

questions.q: Choose the best response.
questions.why: Can I have the car key? と鍵を頼まれているので、渡す返事が自然。サッカーをしたのは息子で、母ではない。

sets.script:
W: Hello, this is Sarah Lee. I have an appointment with Dr. Brown at three today.
M: Yes, Ms. Lee. How can I help you?
W: I'm sorry, but I can't come today. Could I change it to tomorrow?

questions.q: Choose the best response.
choices: Let me check. How about ten in the morning?
questions.why: 予約を明日に変えたいと頼まれたので、空いている時間を伝える。医者の人柄や、昨日来たことは頼みへの答えにならない。

sets.script:
M: Excuse me. Is there a bank near here?
W: Yes, there's one on Main Street, next to the post office.
M: Thank you. Is it close enough to walk there from here?

questions.q: Choose the best response.
choices: Yes, it takes about five minutes.
No, I don't have any money.
questions.why: 歩いて行ける距離かを聞いているので、かかる時間で答える。営業日やお金の話はずれている。

sets.script:
W: Dad, I'd really like to learn how to play the guitar.
M: That sounds fun. Do you want to take lessons?
W: Yes. My friend Kate takes lessons at a music school near the station.

questions.q: Choose the best response.
choices: OK. Let's go and see it this weekend.
No, I don't like music very much.
questions.why: 娘はケイトが通う音楽教室に行きたいと伝えている。父の返事は「今週末に見に行こう」が自然。ほかの2つは習いたいという話に答えていない。

sets.script:
M: Hi. I'd like two tickets for the seven o'clock movie, please.
W: I'm sorry, sir, but that show is already sold out.
M: Oh, no. When does the next one start?

questions.q: Choose the best response.
questions.why: When does the next one start? には時刻で答える。値段や席の話は質問に答えていない。

sets.script:
W: Tom, how was your first day at your new school?
M: It was OK, but I didn't know anyone in my class, so I ate lunch alone.
W: Don't worry. I'm sure you'll make lots of friends soon.

questions.q: Choose the best response.
questions.why: 「すぐに友達ができるよ」という励ましには「そうだといいな」。make friends の make につられて I made it を選ばない。

sets.script:
M: Excuse me, ma'am. I think you dropped this glove.
W: Oh, thank you so much! It was a present from my daughter.
M: You're welcome. It's really cold today, isn't it?

questions.q: Choose the best response.
choices: Yes. I heard it may snow tonight.
No, I don't have a daughter.
I bought it at a department store.
questions.why: isn't it? と天気について同意を求めているので、Yes で寒さの話を続ける。手袋は娘からのプレゼントなので、ほかの2つは矛盾する。

sets.script:
W: Hi, Mike. Are you going to the school festival on Saturday?
M: Yes. My class is going to sell homemade cookies there.
W: Really? That sounds nice. What kind of cookies are you going to make?

questions.q: Choose the best response.
questions.why: What kind of ～?（どんな種類の）には種類で答える。時刻（When）や一緒にいる人（Who）の答えはずれている。

sets.script:
M: Good evening. Welcome to the Sunny Hotel. How can I help you?
W: I'd like to check in, please. My name is Anna White.
M: Thank you, Ms. White. How many nights will you be staying with us?

questions.q: Choose the best response.
questions.why: How many nights? には泊まる日数で答える。誰と来たか（Who with）や交通手段は聞かれていない。

sets.script:
W: Kevin, you're late again. The meeting started fifteen minutes ago.
M: I'm really sorry. My train stopped for a while because of strong winds.
W: I see. But please try to leave home a little earlier next time.

questions.q: Choose the best response.
choices: I will. It won't happen again.
questions.why: 「次はもっと早く家を出て」と注意されたので、「そうします」と約束する。電車で来たので「いつも車」は矛盾する。

sets.script:
M: Grandma, can I help you with anything?
W: Yes, please. Could you carry these shopping bags to the kitchen for me?
M: Sure. Wow, they're really heavy. What's inside them?

questions.q: Choose the best response.
questions.why: What's inside?（中身は何）には中に入っている物を答える。運ぶ場所はもう伝えてある。

sets.script:
W: Excuse me. Do you sell batteries for cameras here?
M: Yes, we do. They're in aisle five, next to the phone cases.
W: Thanks. And do you also sell memory cards?

questions.q: Choose the best response.
choices: No, I don't have a camera.
Yes, they're in the same aisle.
questions.why: 店員に売っているか聞いているので、場所と一緒に答える。カメラを持っているかは聞かれていない。

sets.script:
M: Lisa, what are you going to do during the summer vacation?
W: I'm going to visit my aunt in Canada. She lives near a beautiful lake.
M: That sounds wonderful. How long will you stay there?

questions.q: Choose the best response.
questions.why: How long ～?（どのくらいの間）には期間で答える。交通手段や過去の時は質問とずれている。

sets.script:
W: Honey, the TV isn't working.
M: Really? It was fine last night when I watched the baseball game.
W: I've pressed the button on the remote control many times, but nothing happens.

questions.q: Choose the best response.
choices: Let me check the batteries in it.
questions.why: リモコンのボタンを押しても動かない、という困りごとに対して、電池を調べてみる、が解決の一歩。

sets.script:
M: Ms. Green, may I ask you a question about the history homework?
W: Of course, Daniel. What is it?
M: Do we have to write the report by hand, or can we type it?

questions.q: Choose the best response.
choices: You can use a computer if you like.
It's about the history of our town.
questions.why: 手書きかパソコンかを聞かれているので、パソコンでもよいと答える。レポートの内容は聞かれていない。

sets.script:
W: Good evening. Welcome to Blue Ocean Restaurant. Do you have a reservation?
M: No, we don't. Do you have a table for three people?
W: I'm afraid you'll have to wait for about twenty minutes.

questions.q: Choose the best response.
questions.why: 20分待つ必要があると言われたので、待つかどうかを答える。予約は無いと言ったので、Yes, we made one は矛盾する。

sets.script:
M: Hello, Mrs. Jones. This is Paul. Is Emily at home?
W: Hi, Paul. Sorry, she's at her piano lesson right now.
M: I see. Do you know what time she'll be back?

questions.q: Choose the best response.
questions.why: what time she'll be back（何時に帰るか）には時刻で答える。ピアノの腕前や始めた時期は聞かれていない。

sets.script:
W: I'm going to make spaghetti with tomato sauce for dinner tonight.
M: Great! I love your spaghetti. Do we have everything we need?
W: Well, we don't have any tomatoes, and the sauce needs a lot of them.

questions.q: Choose the best response.
questions.why: トマトが無いという問題に対して、買いに行くと申し出るのが自然。Great! I love your spaghetti と言った後なので、パスタが嫌いは矛盾する。

sets.script:
W: Excuse me. I'd like to borrow this book, but I forgot my library card.
M: Do you have any other card with your name on it, like a student card?
W: Yes, I have my student card. Is that OK?

questions.q: Choose the best response.
choices: No, the library is closed today.
You can buy that book next door.
Sure. Let me see it, please.
questions.why: 学生証で大丈夫かと聞かれているので、「はい、見せてください」が自然。図書館はもう開いていて、買う話はしていない。

sets.script:
M: Mom, I'm going to the park to play basketball with Kyle.
W: OK, but it'll be dark soon. What time will you come home?
M: Before dinner. Can you call me when it's ready?

questions.q: Choose the best response.
choices: All right. Don't forget your phone.
The park is near the station.
questions.why: 夕食ができたら電話して、と頼まれているので、「いいよ。電話を忘れないでね」が合う。昨日の夕食や公園の場所は頼みへの返事になっていない。

sets.script:
W: Good morning. I'd like to check out of my room, please.
M: Certainly. Did you enjoy your stay?
W: Yes, very much. Could you call a taxi to take me to the airport?

questions.q: Choose the best response.
choices: Of course. It will be here in ten minutes.
Yes, I stayed here last year.
questions.why: タクシーを呼んでと頼まれたホテルの人は、「もちろん。10分で来ます」と答える。去年泊まった、は客の言うこと。

parts.title: リスニング第2部 会話の内容一致選択
parts.desc: 2人の会話と質問を聞き、答えを印刷された4つから選ぶ。放送は1回
parts.tip: 放送の前に4つの選択肢を見て、何が問われるか（場所・理由・これからの行動）を予想する。会話の途中で予定や答えが変わる（Sorry, ～ / Then ～）ので最後まで聞く。正解は言い換えが多い（too small → does not fit）。
parts.intro: Listen to the conversation and the question. Choose the best answer from the four choices.

sets.script:
W: Hi, Tom. Did you finish the science report?
M: Not yet. I still need to find some information about frogs.
W: Why don't you go to the city library? It has lots of books about animals.
M: Good idea. I'll go there after school today. Do you want to come with me?
W: Sorry, I have band practice.
Question: What will the boy do after school today?

questions.q: What will the boy do after school today?
questions.why: 男の子は I'll go there after school today と言っている。there は市立図書館。バンドの練習があるのは女の子。

sets.script:
M: Excuse me. I bought this sweater here yesterday, but it's too small for me.
W: I'm sorry. Would you like a bigger size?
M: Yes, but I'd also like a different color. Do you have it in blue?
W: Let me check. Yes, here's a large one in blue.
M: Perfect. Thank you.
Question: What is the man's problem?

questions.q: What is the man's problem?
choices: The store has no blue sweaters.
His sweater does not fit him.
questions.why: 冒頭で「昨日買ったセーターが小さすぎる」と言っている。too small を does not fit と言い換えている。青いセーターは店にあった。

sets.script:
W: Dad, can you drive me to Mika's house this afternoon?
M: Sorry, I have to work today. Can't you ride your bike?
W: My bike has a flat tire.
M: Then why don't you take the bus? The bus stop is right in front of our house.
W: OK, I'll do that.
Question: How will the girl go to Mika's house?

questions.q: How will the girl go to Mika's house?
questions.why: 父は仕事で送れず、自転車はパンク。父の「バスで行けば？」に女の子は I'll do that と答えている。

sets.script:
M: Hello, Green Park Tennis Club.
W: Hi. I'd like to take tennis lessons. Do you have any classes for beginners?
M: Yes. We have beginner classes on Tuesday and Friday evenings.
W: I work late on Tuesdays, so Friday is better for me. How much is it?
M: It's thirty dollars a month.
Question: What does the woman want to do?

questions.q: What does the woman want to do?
choices: Join a tennis class on Fridays.
questions.why: 女性は初心者クラスを受けたく、火曜は仕事が遅いので金曜がいいと言っている。遅くまで働くのは火曜。

sets.script:
W: Jim, you look sleepy. Did you stay up late?
M: Yes. My neighbor's dog barked all night, so I couldn't sleep.
W: That's terrible. Did you talk to your neighbor about it?
M: Not yet. They just moved in last week, so I don't know them well.
W: Maybe you should go and say hello first.
Question: Why couldn't Jim sleep?

questions.q: Why couldn't Jim sleep?
choices: He was moving to a new house.
He was studying for a test.
questions.why: 近所の犬が一晩中ほえていたから。barked を making noise と言い換えている。引っ越してきたのは近所の人。

sets.script:
M: Mom, I want to make dinner for Grandpa's birthday.
W: That's a nice idea. What do you want to make?
M: His favorite food is fish, so I'll make grilled fish. Can you teach me how to cook it?
W: Sure. Let's go to the supermarket together tomorrow and buy what we need.
Question: What will the boy and his mother do tomorrow?

questions.q: What will the boy and his mother do tomorrow?
questions.why: 母の最後の発言：明日一緒にスーパーへ行って必要な物を買おう。fish につられて Go fishing を選ばない。

sets.script:
W: Excuse me. Does this train stop at Riverside Station?
M: No, this is an express train. It only stops at large stations.
W: Oh, no. I need to get there by ten.
M: Get off at the next station and change to a local train. You'll be there in time.
W: Thank you so much.
Question: What does the man tell the woman to do?

questions.q: What does the man tell the woman to do?
choices: Change trains at the next station.
Wait for the next express train.
questions.why: 男性は「次の駅で降りて各駅停車に乗り換えて」と言っている。change to a local train を Change trains とまとめている。

sets.script:
M: Hi, Rachel. How was your trip to London?
W: It was wonderful. I visited many museums, and the food was better than I expected.
M: Did you go to see a musical?
W: I wanted to, but the tickets were too expensive. I'll go next time.
M: That's a good plan.
Question: Why didn't Rachel see a musical?

questions.q: Why didn't Rachel see a musical?
questions.why: ミュージカルを見たかったが、チケットが高すぎた。too expensive を cost too much と言い換えている。

sets.script:
W: Peter, are you going to enter the school's English speech contest?
M: I'm thinking about it, but I'm not sure what to talk about.
W: You lived in Australia for two years, right? Why don't you talk about that?
M: That's a good idea. I could talk about the animals I saw there.
Question: What will Peter probably talk about?

questions.q: What will Peter probably talk about?
questions.why: オーストラリアに住んでいた話を勧められ、「そこで見た動物について話せる」と答えている。

sets.script:
M: Excuse me. I'm looking for a book about gardening for beginners.
W: Gardening books are on the second floor, next to the cookbooks.
M: Thanks. Do you also have magazines about gardening?
W: Yes, but the magazines are on the first floor, near the entrance.
Question: Where are the gardening books?

questions.q: Where are the gardening books?
questions.why: 園芸の本は2階の料理本の隣。1階の入り口近くにあるのは雑誌。

sets.script:
W: Hello. I'd like to make an appointment for a haircut.
M: Sure. When would you like to come?
W: Is Saturday morning OK?
M: I'm sorry, but Saturday is full. We have time on Sunday at eleven.
W: That's fine. I'll come then.
Question: When will the woman get her haircut?

questions.q: When will the woman get her haircut?
questions.why: 土曜は予約でいっぱいで、日曜の11時を勧められ、女性は I'll come then と答えている。11時なので午前。

sets.script:
M: Lucy, are you coming to the beach with us tomorrow?
W: I'd love to, but I have to look after my little brother. My parents are going out.
M: Why don't you bring him with you?
W: Really? He loves the beach. I'll ask my parents tonight.
Question: What will Lucy do tonight?

questions.q: What will Lucy do tonight?
choices: Buy a present for her brother.
Ask her parents about going to the beach.
questions.why: 最後の発言：今夜両親に聞いてみる。弟を海に連れて行ってよいかを聞く。出かけるのは両親だけ。

sets.script:
W: Mark, have you seen my history textbook? I can't find it.
M: I think you left it in the living room yesterday.
W: I already looked there. It wasn't there.
M: Then maybe it's in your school locker.
W: Oh, you're right. I put it there on Friday. I remember now.
Question: Where is the girl's textbook?

questions.q: Where is the girl's textbook?
questions.why: 居間には無かった。「学校のロッカーでは？」に「そうだ、金曜に入れた」と答えている。

sets.script:
M: Hi. I'd like to send this letter to France.
W: Sure. Would you like to send it by airmail?
M: How long will it take?
W: About one week. Express mail is faster, but it costs three times as much.
M: One week is fine. Airmail, please.
Question: How will the man send his letter?

questions.q: How will the man send his letter?
questions.why: 速達は速いが3倍の値段。男性は「1週間でいい。航空便で」と言っている。

sets.script:
W: Dan, our club needs someone to make posters for the school festival.
M: Why are you asking me? I'm not good at art.
W: You don't have to draw. We need someone to make posters on the computer.
M: Oh, I can do that. I often use design software at home.
Question: What will Dan probably do?

questions.q: What will Dan probably do?
questions.why: 絵を描かなくてよく、パソコンでポスターを作る人が必要と言われ、ダンは I can do that と答えている。

sets.script:
M: Mom, can I keep this cat? I found it near the park.
W: It looks very clean. It might belong to someone.
M: It has a collar, but there's no name on it.
W: Let's put up a notice at the supermarket. If no one calls, then we'll talk about it.
Question: What does the boy's mother suggest?

questions.q: What does the boy's mother suggest?
choices: Taking the cat to a zoo.
questions.why: 母は「スーパーにお知らせを貼ろう。誰からも電話が無ければ話し合おう」と言っている。すぐに飼うとは言っていない。

sets.script:
W: Excuse me. Is this seat free?
M: Yes, it is. Please sit down.
W: Thank you. Are you going to the concert at City Hall, too?
M: Yes. My daughter is playing the violin in it. It's her first concert.
W: How exciting!
Question: Why is the man going to the concert?

questions.q: Why is the man going to the concert?
choices: He is going to play the violin.
His daughter is performing in it.
questions.why: 娘がそのコンサートでバイオリンを弾くから。playing を performing と言い換えている。弾くのは男性ではない。

sets.script:
M: Kate, how is your new part-time job at the bakery?
W: I like it, but I have to start work at six in the morning.
M: Wow, that's early. Is it hard to get up?
W: Yes, but I can take home the bread that doesn't sell. My family loves it.
Question: What does Kate like about her job?

questions.q: What does Kate like about her job?
questions.why: 朝6時からで大変だが、売れ残ったパンを持ち帰れて家族が喜ぶ。始業は早い。

sets.script:
W: Hi, Ben. Are you ready for the basketball game on Saturday?
M: Actually, I hurt my ankle during practice yesterday.
W: Oh, no! Can you still play?
M: The doctor said I need to rest for two weeks. I'll still go to the game and cheer for my team, though.
Question: What will Ben do on Saturday?

questions.q: What will Ben do on Saturday?
questions.why: 足首を痛めて2週間休む必要があるが、試合には行ってチームを応援する。cheer for を Watch でまとめている。

sets.script:
M: Welcome to Pizza Town. Are you ready to order?
W: Yes. I'd like a large vegetable pizza and two orange juices, please.
M: I'm sorry, but we've run out of orange juice. How about apple juice instead?
W: OK, that's fine.
Question: What is one thing the woman will get?

questions.q: What is one thing the woman will get?
questions.why: オレンジジュースは売り切れで、代わりのリンゴジュースに OK と答えている。ピザは野菜のLサイズ。

sets.script:
W: Sam, are you going to the summer festival this Saturday?
M: I want to, but I have to work at my uncle's restaurant until six.
W: The fireworks start at eight. Why don't we meet at the station at seven?
M: Sounds great. I'll see you there.
Question: Where will they meet?

questions.q: Where will they meet?
questions.why: 女性の Why don't we meet at the station at seven? に男性が Sounds great と答えている。レストランは男性が6時まで働く場所。

sets.script:
W: Excuse me. I bought this lamp here last week, but it doesn't turn on.
M: I'm sorry about that. Do you have the receipt?
W: Yes, here it is. Can I get a new one?
M: I'm afraid that lamp is sold out. But I can give you your money back.
W: OK. I'll do that.
Question: What will the woman probably do?

questions.q: What will the woman probably do?
choices: Get the same kind of lamp.
questions.why: 同じランプは売り切れで、店員の「代金を返せます」に女性は I'll do that と答えている。同じランプはもう無い。

sets.script:
M: Hi, Ellen. You look happy today.
W: I am. My grandparents are coming from Canada tomorrow.
M: That's nice. How long will they stay?
W: For two weeks. We're going to take them to the mountains this weekend.
M: Have a great time.
Question: What will Ellen's family do this weekend?

questions.q: What will Ellen's family do this weekend?
choices: Meet her grandparents at the airport.
